message: Hey everyone, just a reminder to share any health updates! How's Simon doing with his new meditation routine?
Simon's been feeling a lot better lately, he's managing stress well with mindfulness exercises and sticking to his prescribed medication, his Sertraline 50mg daily.
That's great to hear! It's important to balance medication with activities. I'm glad Simon's meditation is helping him too.
Yoga has been a game changer for my mental health as well. Combining it with my anxiety meds, my Buspirone 10mg twice a day, has really helped.
Absolutely, and let's not forget about maintaining a healthy diet alongside our medications. My Omega-3 supplements have been a good addition for me.
Simon, we're all supporting you. Your dedication to taking your Escitalopram 10mg every morning is inspiring. Keep it up!
Can't wait to catch up at the family BBQ and chat about how we're all managing. I've found therapy combined with my Wellbutrin XL 150mg really beneficial.
The meditation app has been a lifesaver. Paired with my nightly routine of Mirtazapine 15mg, my sleep quality has improved drastically.
While we're sharing, I've been on Venlafaxine 75mg for a few months now. If anyone's considering it, I'm open to discussing my experience.
Remember, it's not just about physical health, mental well-being is just as important! Regular check-ins with our psychiatrist and staying on top of our prescriptions is key.
